cards.title: Browser and frontend
items: Next.js App Router serves the workspace; /api/v1 rewrites to BACKEND_ORIGIN. No separate frontend database connection.
React 19.3.0, Next.js 16.4.3, Tailwind CSS 4.3.3, Tiptap 3.32.2 and Yjs 13.6.33 are lockfile versions.
Yjs updates and presence use HTTP polling; this is not a WebSocket deployment.

cards.title: One backend, multiple domains
items: Node.js 24 / npm 11; TypeScript 5.9.3 and Fastify 5.12.7. Modules execute inside one backend, not separate microservices.

Identity, records, projects, work coordination, scheduling, knowledge, providers, capture, automation, search, portability, context, planning, kits, meeting briefs, integration settings, enterprise settings and future-discovery routes are registered.
The detailed source-to-module and technology inventories are in docs/architecture/README.md.

cards.title: Identity and data authority
items: Opaque server sessions, scrypt passwords, Origin + CSRF checks on authenticated mutations and live membership checks.
Scoped transactions set tantu.actor / tantu.tenant; PostgreSQL row security and grants govern record access. Runtime roles must not be superusers, bypass RLS or own canonical tables.
Canonical saves atomically persist the operation result, record version, revision, event and pg-boss enqueue. Changed-payload operation reuse and stale versions return conflicts.

cards.title: Durable asynchronous work
items: PostgreSQL contains both canonical data and the tantu_jobs queue; Redis, Kafka and a separate queue service are not part of this implementation.
Queues: canonical-events, file-scans, provider-sync, provider-effects; dead-letters receives exhausted internal jobs. Four retries with backoff and a 60-second job expiration.
Worker recovery checks every 30 seconds and queues due provider reads. External writes use separate uncertainty fences; unknown sends are reconciled rather than blindly replayed.

cards.title: Integration boundaries
items: Google and Microsoft require operator credentials, a 32-byte vault key and user consent. Tokens are AES-256-GCM encrypted; outbound API URLs are allowlisted and requests bounded.
The API performs reviewed mail-send operations; the worker performs queued calendar/mailbox effects and provider-read pages. SMTP is the separate signup verification path.
Real provider registration, public callbacks and production qualification are environment-dependent; source presence alone does not establish a live connection.

cards.title: Deployment and honest limits
items: Docker Compose defines frontend, backend, worker, PostgreSQL, one-shot migrator and scanner with shared private file storage. Its commands run development watch processes.
The Compose scanner recognizes synthetic/EICAR markers only. Production file release requires a real qualified malware engine; an unavailable endpoint keeps files unavailable.
AI meeting briefs currently use deterministic database assembly. SSO enforcement is rejected as unconfigured. No hosting deployment adapter is configured in deploy.yml.

cards.title: Evidence and scope
items: Source links are pinned to Git revision 4739adf6a360658bf57fb3e792b685dea42f9d2c. Existing uncommitted UI/invitation work is not represented as committed evidence.
This is a runtime overview; module details, schema families, contracts, recovery and synchronization commands are documented alongside the diagrams.
Source inspection establishes implementation structure, not production certification or the outcome of every application test.
